timeCompression.why: Wait 1 Minute waits 60 seconds before each urlscan.io report is fetched. Shortened to 1 second on both sides. This changes when the run resumes, not what it does: the mock answers the report by scan id, not by elapsed time, and no expression in the template reads $now. Not a placeholder fill, so results flag it as time compression (config.nonPlaceholder).
